author: Ali Dogan
name: Monoslice Module
description: Adds a module (implementation, Contracts and unit tests) to a Monoslice solution. Run it from the solution root.

postActions.description: Restore NuGet packages required by the module.
Add the module projects to the solution.

manualInstructions.text: Add the generated projects to the solution with 'dotnet sln add'.

postActions.description: Add the unit test project to the solution.

manualInstructions.text: Add the test project to the solution with 'dotnet sln add'.

The Api references every module automatically. Register the module in src/Bootstrapper/Api/ModuleRegistry.cs ('new <Name>.<Name>Module(),') and create its first migration: dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate -p src/Modules/<Name>/<Name> -s src/Bootstrapper/Api -o Data/Migrations
